Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output.
